d: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

As an Account Manager at Talabat (Qatar), you will be responsible for managing and growing relationships with our restaurant and vendor partners. You will serve as the main point of contact, helping them optimize their presence on our platform, grow their sales, and ensure a high level of partner satisfaction.
Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing restaurant and vendor partners.
Ensure high partner satisfaction and retention through proactive communication, support, and service excellence.
Serve as a trusted advisor, providing partners with insights that support their business growth on the platform.
Analyze sales, operational, and engagement data to identify areas for improvement in menu performance, pricing, promotions, and delivery logistics.
Share actionable recommendations based on performance metrics to drive revenue and efficiency.
Conduct regular business reviews to align on results, opportunities, and growth plans.
Identify growth opportunities within the portfolio – upsell services, suggest cross-promotions, and improve partner performance.
Support partners in optimizing content (e.g., menu structure, images, delivery times) for better customer engagement and conversion.
Recommend and coordinate marketing campaigns and promotional offers to drive order volume.
Collaborate closely with internal teams such as Marketing, Logistics, and Operations to address partner needs and resolve issues promptly.
Ensure smooth onboarding, campaign execution, and issue resolution for assigned accounts.
Negotiate and renew commercial agreements to ensure a fair and strategic partnership.
Ensure partners comply with service-level agreements and maintain operational standards, including delivery quality and availability.
q: 2+ years of experience in Account Management, Sales, or Partner Success (experience in food tech, FMCG, or e-commerce is a plus).
Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with data dashboards and Excel/Google Sheets to analyze performance and generate insights.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Customer-first mindset with a strong focus on delivering value to partners.
Self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Fluency in Arabic Language is a must

d: Nabeh, a subsidiary of Master Works, delivers AI-powered solutions that help organizations automate operations, boost efficiency, and drive innovation. Its expertise spans computer vision, LLM applications, speech-to-text, data intelligence, and low-code AI solutions.

Nabeh is looking for an AI Product Engineer (LLM & Agentic AI) to develop and deploy production-ready AI applications using LLMs, RAG, and Agentic AI, contributing to Nabeh's AI products and enterprise solutions.
q: Hands-on experience integrating and developing applications using LLM APIs or open-source models.
Proven experience with RAG architectures and vector databases.
Experience with at least one agent or LLM orchestration framework such as LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
Strong API development experience using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
Familiarity with Docker, Linux, Git, and production deployment workflows.
Experience with SQL databases and asynchronous backend processing.
Strong understanding of model parameters, tokenization, context windows, embeddings, and LLM evaluation.
Ability to independently develop production-ready AI features.
Fluency in both Arabic and English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
Experience with vLLM, Hugging Face Transformers, LiteLLM, or other inference frameworks.
Experience building enterprise AI agents with tool calling, memory, and workflow orchestration.
Knowledge of speech AI pipelines including STT, TTS, and real-time voice agents.
Familiarity with model quantization, GPU utilization, and inference performance tuning.
Experience working with NVIDIA or Qualcomm AI acceleration infrastructure.
Knowledge of Kubernetes, Redis, Kafka, or distributed application architectures.
Experience with AI security, prompt-injection prevention, and PII filtering.
r: Design and develop enterprise AI applications powered by proprietary and open-source LLMs.
Build advanced RAG pipelines for ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded responses.
Develop AI agents capable of tool calling, multi-step task execution, and integration with enterprise systems.
Implement multi-agent and workflow-based AI solutions with reliable execution and error handling.
Develop structured output pipelines, prompt templates, and context-management strategies.
Build conversational AI capabilities supporting multilingual interactions, particularly Arabic and English.
Integrate multiple AI providers through OpenAI-compatible APIs.
Deploy and serve open-source LLMs using inference frameworks such as vLLM.
Work with cloud-hosted and on-premises inference infrastructure.
Optimize inference latency, throughput, concurrency, token usage, and cost.
Implement model routing, fallback mechanisms, request logging, usage tracking, and API integration.
Support deployments on NVIDIA GPUs and other AI accelerators, including Qualcomm Cloud AI platforms.
Build reliable backend services using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI.
Design RESTful APIs, asynchronous workers, streaming responses, and event-driven integrations.
Work with SQL and vector databases such as PostgreSQL, pgvector, Qdrant, or Milvus.
Integrate AI services into enterprise workflows, knowledge systems, and third-party applications.
Containerize applications using Docker and support Kubernetes-based deployments.
Implement observability, automated testing, CI/CD, and production monitoring.
Develop evaluation pipelines measuring answer quality, grounding, hallucination rates, latency, and cost.
Implement prompt-injection defenses, access controls, PII protection, and content guardrails.
Support secure AI deployments aligned with enterprise privacy requirements.
Evaluate and benchmark new LLMs, embeddings, reranking models, and inference approaches.
Troubleshoot production issues across application, model, and inference layers.
Collaborate with product managers to convert requirements into functional AI capabilities.
Own assigned features from technical design and implementation to deployment and monitoring.
Deliver maintainable, reusable components rather than isolated POCs.
Participate in architecture reviews, technical documentation, code reviews, and product demonstrations.

d: Siemens Mobility (SMO) is the world’s leading provider of mobility solutions that enable the efficient, safe, and environmentally friendly transport of people and goods—helping to improve the quality of everyday life for millions worldwide.

Motivated by innovation, we develop intelligent solutions for the growing digitalization of the transport sector. Our offerings include rail vehicles, rail automation, road traffic management systems, rail electrification, and services.

In Oman, Siemens Mobility is delivering the signaling, telecom, and power supply systems for the 303 km Abu Dhabi-Sohar railway, which marks the first cross-country railway network in the Middle East, connecting the UAE and Oman.

Today, we are recruiting for a Site EHS Officer to join our team in Oman. This is an excellent career opportunity for professionals looking to join a truly international team in one of the biggest projects of Siemens Mobility.
r: Act as the key contact for Health, Safety, and Environmental matters at the assigned project sites, ensuring compliance with Siemens EHS principles, project requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable local and international regulations.
Conduct regular site inspections, identify potential EHS risks and non-compliance issues, and define, implement, and monitor appropriate corrective and preventive measures.
Support the implementation and maintenance of ISO 45001 Occupational Health & Safety Management System and ISO 14001 Environmental Management System requirements across the project.
Monitor compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety legislation and ensure that relevant requirements are effectively implemented on site.
Prepare detailed EHS reports covering inspection findings, audit results, incidents, corrective actions, performance indicators, and overall compliance status.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of EHS performance metrics, incidents, near misses, training, inspections, audits, and regulatory submissions.
Ensure that incidents and near misses are properly reported, investigated, documented, and followed up, including root-cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor the EHS performance of subcontractors and consortium partners, conduct assessments, provide feedback, and escalate significant non-compliance to the EHS Manager and Project Manager.
Support the Project Manager and EHS Manager in obtaining and maintaining required EHS permits, authorizations, certificates, and regulatory notifications.
Review subcontractor Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS), Risk Assessments, and Permit to Work (PTW) documentation to ensure compliance with project and EHS requirements.
Ensure that EHS requirements and the project EHS plan are clearly communicated to employees, subcontractors, and other relevant stakeholders.
Conduct and record safety meetings, toolbox talks, site inductions, and other EHS communication activities.
Develop and maintain the EHS training matrix, identify training needs, and ensure completion of mandatory internal and third-party EHS training requirements.
Conduct emergency response drills in accordance with the approved project schedule and support continuous improvement of emergency preparedness.
Monitor EHS KPIs and targets, support project audits, and develop corrective action plans to address identified gaps.
Liaise with customers, contractors, regulatory authorities, consultants, and other stakeholders on EHS matters in coordination with the Project Manager and EHS Manager.
Support the identification and management of environmental risks, including requirements related to controlled or declarable substances used on the project.
Respond to emergencies, incidents, and near misses and coordinate with relevant emergency response teams to minimize impact and ensure appropriate follow-up.
Share lessons learned and best practices and contribute to the continuous improvement of EHS processes, procedures, and initiatives.
Support the evaluation of contractors' EHS performance and provide relevant feedback to the Project Procurement Manager and EHS Manager.
What Do I Need to Qualify for This Job?
Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Electrical, Civil, or a related discipline.
3 to 5 years of experience in Health, Safety & Environment, preferably within construction, infrastructure, installation, or railway projects.
NEBOSH IGC certification, with a Merit pass achieved before 2022.
Lead Auditor certification in ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.
Basic or Advanced First Aid certification.
Valid Oman/GCC driving license is mandatory.
Practical knowledge of Permit to Work (PTW) systems for installation activities in both greenfield and brownfield environments, including online and offline processes.
Strong knowledge of incident investigation processes, including root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and preparation of detailed investigation reports.
Good understanding of EHS risk assessment, mitigation measures, and health and safety best practices.
Experience in railway projects is considered an advantage.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively with multicultural teams and lead by example in promoting a strong EHS culture.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in challenging site environments.
Strong presentation skills with the ability to communicate EHS requirements, present performance data, and influence stakeholders.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and other relevant computer applications.
CertIOSH or equivalent professional EHS membership is considered an advantage.
Fluency in written and spoken English is required. Knowledge of additional regional languages, including Hindi, is considered an advantage.
Willingness and ability to travel frequently between project locations and work in challenging site conditions as required.
